title: Kimi read-only reviewer's Engram MCP read calls (next --peek, memories, show) are declined while Codex and Claude reviewers in the same round succeed
outcome: Kimi read-only reviewer's Engram MCP read calls (next --peek, memories, show) are declined while Codex and Claude reviewers in the same round succeed
acceptance: A cause note identifies why the Kimi reviewer child's Engram read calls were declined (tool exposure, read-only policy mapping, runtime permission prompt handling, or binding) with file:line and evidence from supported surfaces only

A read-only Kimi reviewer can perform the same read-only Engram calls (next with peek, memories, show) that Codex and Claude read-only reviewers can, or, if Kimi deliberately has no Engram route, the spawn result and reviewer brief say so explicitly; a deterministic test covers the chosen behaviour
Exact-input focused tests, the full five-stage gate and an independent review pair with no outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher finding
